cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of preview-report (stakeholder-preview-packet-formatter) with contract handoff to pre-handoff-verification
cases.inputPrompt: Use preview-report to format a stakeholder preview packet for a Path 1 host (a) run where `renders/watch-hero.png` and `exports/watch.glb` exist on disk but quality checks are still Not Run.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (classified_artifact_evidence) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet, truth_state_and_provenance_summary, pre_handoff_gate_submission for role stakeholder-preview-packet-formatter
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to pre-handoff-verification (Handoff gate (gates handoffs before downstream delivery))
forbiddenOutputProperties: upgraded Produced to Verified without validation
evidenceRequirements: Outputs stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet, truth_state_and_provenance_summary, pre_handoff_gate_submission conforming to skills/preview-report/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to pre-handoff-verification in skills/preview-report/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet and hand off to pre-handoff-verification (Handoff gate (gates handoffs before downstream delivery)).
simulatedOutput.summary: Formatted canonical stakeholder preview report recording Path 1 host (a) provenance, artifact paths, and conservative `Artifact: Produced` (not Verified) labels pending quality gates. Delivered canonical preview report, Artifact: Produced, Path 1 and routed to pre-handoff-verification.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in preview-report
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during preview-report with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for preview-report and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/preview-report/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for preview-report.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'classified_artifact_evidence' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing artifact file paths, runtime path metadata, and validation gate verdicts required by preview-report (classified_artifact_evidence)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: artifact file paths, runtime path metadata, and validation gate verdicts
forbiddenOutputProperties: upgraded Produced to Verified without validation
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'classified_artifact_evidence' (artifact file paths, runtime path metadata, and validation gate verdicts)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing artifact file paths, runtime path metadata, and validation gate verdicts (classified_artifact_evidence) before preview-report locks stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet.
